m: 1. अञ्च् (connected with √ अच्, q.v.) cl. 1. P. Ā. अञ्चति, ˚ते, आनञ्च, ˚चे, अञ्चिष्यति, ˚ते, अञ्चितुम्, to bend, curve, incline, curl; to reverence (with inclined body), to honour; to tend, move, go, wander about; to request, L. : cl. 10. or Caus. अञ्चयति, to unfold, make clear, produce. Desid. P. Ā. अञ्चिचिषति, ˚ते, to be desirous of bending: Pass. अञ्च्यते or अच्यते, to be bent.
2. अञ्च् only ifc., turned to, going or directed towards;
see see अकुध्र्यञ्च्, अवाञ्च्, उदञ्च्, देवद्र्यञ्च्, &c.
अञ्च ‘curling’ (of the hairs of the body, thrill of rapture), only at the end of रोमाञ्च, q.v.

m: अञ्चल m. (perhaps also अम्) n. the border or end of a garment, especially of a woman's garment, of a veil, shawl. (in Bengālī, a strip of country, district.)
अञ्चन n. act of bending or curving.

gone, walked in
reverenced, honoured
distinguished.

अञ्चित—लाङ्गूल mfn. having a curved tail (as a monkey).
अञ्चित—पत्त्राक्ष mfn. having lotus eyes.
अञ्चित—पत्त्र m. a kind of lotus with curved leaves.

अञ्ज् cl. 7. P. Ā. अनक्ति, अङ्क्ते, आनञ्ज, अञ्जिष्यति or अङ्क्ष्यति, आञ्जीत्, अञ्जितुम् or अङ्क्तुम्, to apply an ointment or pigment, smear with, anoint; to decorate, prepare; to honour, celebrate; to cause to appear, make clear, RV. i, 92, 1; to be beautiful, L.; to go, L. : Caus. अञ्जयत्, आञ्जिजत्, to smear with; to speak; to shine; to cause to go, L.
अञ्ज् [cf. Lat. ungo].

v: strI॰ aYji + vA NIp । pezaRayantre, maNgale ca ।

अञ्जक m. N. of a son of Vipracitti, VP.

a libation to the Manes (two hands full of water, उदकाञ्जलि), VP. &c.
a measure of corn, sufficient to fill both hands when placed side by side, equal to a kuḍava.

m: अञ्जलि—बन्धन n. salutation with the अञ्जलि raised to the forehead.

अञ्जलि—कर्मन् n. making the above respectful salutation.
अञ्जलि—पुट m. n. cavity produced in making the अञ्जलि salutation.

m: अञ्जन m. a kind of domestic lizard, L.
N. of a fabulous, serpent
of a tree, Pañcat.
of a mountain, of a king of Mithilā, of the elephant of the west or south-west quarter

paint, especially as a cosmetic
magic ointment
ink, L.
night, L.
fire, L. (In rhetoric) making clear the meaning of an equivocal expression, double entendre or pun, &c.

k.v: कुबेरः ईशः पतयः पूर्वादीनां दिशां क्रमात्. रविः शुक्रो महीसूनुः स्वर्भानुर्भानुजो विधुः। बुधो बृहस्पतिश्चेति दिशां चैव तथा ग्रहाः। ऐरावतः पुण्डरीको वामनः कुमुदोऽञ्जनः॥

v: strI aYjanasADanaM SalAkA । aYjanadAnArTa SAlAkAyAm “jYAnAYjanaSalAkayeti” gurunatiH ।
